name: @ccd/ds-v3
description: Workspace root for design system v3. Holds no source of its own — it exists so the dependencies resolve for BOTH the components in v3/components and the workbench in v3/shell. Node resolution only walks up, so a component living beside the workbench rather than inside it cannot see the workbench's node_modules; hoisting here is what makes v3/components the component store and v3/shell merely the thing that renders it.
